mapper.insert: INSERT INTO em_prediction_execution_gate (batch_id, project_id, batch_code, execution_mode, reference_time, contract_version, contract_fingerprint, expected_model_count, actual_model_count, successful_model_count, expected_feature_count, actual_feature_count, expected_steps, expected_point_count, actual_point_count, missing_point_count, invalid_timestamp_count, quality_issue_count, base_time_age_minutes, max_age_minutes, model_set_valid, feature_set_valid, timeline_valid, quality_valid, artifact_hash_valid, freshness_valid, execution_eligible, issues_json, missing_models_json, unexpected_models_json, missing_features_json, unexpected_features_json, missing_timeline_points_json, target_summary_json, gate_hash, evaluated_at) VALUES (#{batchId}, #{projectId}, #{batchCode}, #{executionMode}, #{referenceTime}, #{contractVersion}, #{contractFingerprint}, #{expectedModelCount}, #{actualModelCount}, #{successfulModelCount}, #{expectedFeatureCount}, #{actualFeatureCount}, #{expectedSteps}, #{expectedPointCount}, #{actualPointCount}, #{missingPointCount}, #{invalidTimestampCount}, #{qualityIssueCount}, #{baseTimeAgeMinutes}, #{maxAgeMinutes}, #{modelSetValid}, #{featureSetValid}, #{timelineValid}, #{qualityValid}, #{artifactHashValid}, #{freshnessValid}, #{executionEligible}, #{issuesJson}, #{missingModelsJson}, #{unexpectedModelsJson}, #{missingFeaturesJson}, #{unexpectedFeaturesJson}, #{missingTimelinePointsJson}, #{targetSummaryJson}, #{gateHash}, #{evaluatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id), reference_time = VALUES(reference_time), evaluated_at = VALUES(evaluated_at)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM em_prediction_execution_gate WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} AND execution_mode = #{executionMode} ORDER BY evaluated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
